c74object.name: mc.ear.select~
c74object.digest: Select channels of a multichannel signal by number (1-based), in the order given: 'tracks 7 8 9 10' outputs input channels 7 to 10 as output channels 1 to 4
c74object.description: Select channels of a multichannel signal by number (1-based), in the order given: 'tracks 7 8 9 10' outputs input channels 7 to 10 as output channels 1 to 4. The arguments set the initial selection. ear.adm reports the tracks of each rendering item in this form, so mc.sfplay~ into mc.ear.select~ into a renderer routes a file's objects, bed or scene. The output channel count follows the selection when the audio is restarted; a selected channel the input does not have is silent.

method.name: tracks
method.description: Select input channels by number (1-based): 'tracks 7 8 9 10'. Takes effect on the output channel count when the audio is restarted.
